cloud115.title: 115 Cloud
cloud115.subtitle: Mirror a 115 drive folder into your library and play it straight from the drive.
cloud115.paused: 115 asked us to slow down. Every call is paused for another {seconds}s.
cloud115.cookieKeep: Saved — leave blank to keep it
cloud115.cookieHint: From a signed-in 115.com session: the Cookie header (UID, CID, SEID, KID). It is stored as a setting and never shown again.
cloud115.baseUrlHint: The address players reach this KROMA at, used to build each .strm. Filled in automatically when you start a sync from this page.
cloud115.qrHint: Pick a client neither you nor another tool is using; each client can be online only once.
cloud115.uploadHint: Send a file from this server's library to 115: try instant upload first, then multipart.
cloud115.uploadPathHint: An absolute path under a library folder
cloud115.uploadMissing: Fill in both the drive folder and the local file
cloud115.mappingsHint: Pick the drive folder here; the local side is an absolute storage path (e.g. /media/115/Films), created on save. Media libraries are created separately in KROMA and may point anywhere — they are not tied to this mapping.
cloud115.mappingsNoLibrary: No media library is configured yet — create one in Settings → Libraries first.
cloud115.watchHint: Poll 115's own change log so a file Symedia just organised becomes a .strm within a minute, then triggers a library scan. The full sync stays the backstop.
cloud115.gateOff: 115 life events are off — enable "Recent" in the 115 app
cloud115.pacingHint: 115 counts requests; these numbers are what keeps a mirror looking like a person rather than a script.
cloud115.playLogHint: 115 .strm entries play over a 302 direct link; local files stream through KROMA (Range), never through a 115 link.
cloud115.filesHint: What the mirror sees, read live. One folder costs one call to 115, paced like every other.
cloud115.copyFailed: The browser refused the clipboard; copy this address yourself —
cloud115.truncated: The run stopped at its call budget; the rest continues next time and nothing was removed.
cloud115.loadFailed: The module did not answer; check that it is enabled and running.
cloud115.baseMismatch: This is not the address you are browsing with — play links built from it may fail.
cloud115.indexNotReady: No folder index yet: run “Sync now” once so the watcher knows where events land.
cloud115.pickHint: Pick this folder, or open one below first.
cloud115.unresolved: The local folder is invalid: enter an absolute storage path (e.g. /media/115/Films).
cloud115.skipIsoHint: An ISO cannot be decoded by a browser and this server cannot remux a URL. Off means they are mirrored anyway and will not play.
cloud115.probeHint: Read each new entry's container header over HTTP and write a .info.json beside its .strm, so technical details show without downloading the file. Each probe signs a link and reads a few MB; it counts against the call budget.
cloud115.keepSuffixHint: On: movie.mkv becomes movie.mkv.strm. Off: movie.strm. Old entries need a new sync after switching.
cloud115.overwriteStrmHint: Off skips every existing STRM. On replaces only files whose whole content is this module's play URL; hand-edited files stay.
cloud115.minVideoSizeHint: Videos below this size are not mirrored; 0 disables the floor.
cloud115.prefetchNextHint: How many following episodes have their links warmed when one starts playing. 0 disables it; at most 3.
cloud115.removeAccountWarn: This signs the module out and forgets the local record.
cloud115.removeAccountHint: Nothing is deleted from 115: files, shares and the mappings stay. You will need to sign in again to play or sync.
cloud115.accountAliasHint: Shown on this page only; 115 keeps its own nickname.
cloud115.dailyBudgetHint: Calls allowed per day across the mirror, the watcher and playback; 0 is no ceiling. Background work pauses at 70%, leaving the rest for playback.
cloud115.scheduleHint: A scheduled run walks the mappings even when nothing changed; the watcher handles small changes in between.
cloud115.autoSyncHint: How often a scheduled mirror runs. Off leaves manual runs and the watcher in charge.
cloud115.syncOpsHint: Reset the change cursor or carry the configuration to another server. The cookie is never exported.
cloud115.clearCheckpointWarn: Clears the event cursor and the folder index.
cloud115.clearCheckpointHint: The next full sync rebuilds the index; the watcher cannot map changes until then. Library files are untouched.
cloud115.importConfigHint: Paste a file exported from this module. Mappings, options and the display name are imported; the cookie stays on this server.
cloud115.importInvalid: That is not valid configuration JSON.
cloud115.assetsHint: Copied from 115 beside each STRM; written only when the entry is regenerated, never over an existing local file.
cloud115.syncNfoHint: tvshow.nfo, movie.nfo and episode NFO files.
cloud115.syncSubtitlesHint: srt / ass / ssa / vtt / sup / idx / sub.
cloud115.replaceHint: Rewrite this module's STRM files to the current access address. Preview first, then run; hand-edited files are skipped.
cloud115.cannotClearMappings: A save cannot leave zero mappings — add one row first.
cloud115.localHint: Must start with /media (the storage root), e.g. /media/115/Films; the folder is created on save.
cloud115.loginRequiredHint: Everything in this section is sent as the signed-in 115 account. Sign in by QR on the Account tab, or import a cookie under Advanced.
cloud115.accountHint: Connect by QR or an imported cookie; capacity is read from 115.
cloud115.intervalHint: The least wait between two calls to 115.
cloud115.budgetHint: A sync run stops at this many calls, leaving the rest for playback and other work.
cloud115.folderCapHint: A folder with more entries is skipped and recorded as an error, so the account is not flagged.
cloud115.linkTtlHint: A signed direct link is reused for this long before it is signed again.
cloud115.pageSizeHint: Entries per listing. Larger asks mean fewer calls; 115 caps it at 1150.
cloud115.strmOptionsHint: These only affect the .strm files the module writes; files edited by hand are left alone.
cloud115.watchIntervalHint: The least gap between event polls; the job checks once a minute.
cloud115.syncDirtyHint: Unsaved changes: syncing uses the saved settings.
cloud115.syncBoardHint: Progress comes from the background job; a run that hits its budget resumes next time.
cloud115.transferHint: Paste 115 share links (with extract codes if any), preview them, then pick the entries to keep.
cloud115.transferPlaceholder: Paste share links, one per line; an extract code can ride along as password=.
cloud115.transferMissing: Paste at least one share link first.
cloud115.transferPreviewFailed: The share preview did not complete
cloud115.transferNoEntries: This share has no entries to pick.
cloud115.transferTargetHint: Defaults to the drive root; folders can be picked as entries too.
cloud115.transferPickNone: Pick the entries to save first.
cloud115.transferHistoryHint: The last 50 share saves and how they went.
cloud115.transferNoHistory: No share has been saved yet.
cloud115.runErrorsHint: This run's errors, and the last playback error.
cloud115.savedHint: Saved settings apply to new requests.
